question.question: Can a coalition partner be attacked as an enemy, and does coalition automatically grant Allied relationship powers?

expected.expected_answer: Coalition partners are not enemies so cannot choose partner as battle enemy. Coalition itself does not grant Allied; relationships still separate and hostile partner resets Indifferent.

source_passages.quotation: Coalition partners are not enemies. A Hostile partner becomes Indifferent. Coalition does not by itself grant Allied relationship powers.

answer.ruling: Coalition partners are not enemies, and coalition does not itself grant Allied relationship powers.
